About Thambaiya & Grandson

A dream from the 1970s, now coming true.

In the 1970s, Thambaiya dreamed of starting a company that sold herbal products. He worked very hard for it, but the society of that time was a great obstacle to his success.

Now his grandson has started to make that dream a reality. Thambaiya & Grandson Herbal Treasury is that dream.
